title: Michigan’s Tense Democratic Senate Race Poses a Big Test for a Divided Party
summary: Progressives hope momentum by Dr. Abdul El-Sayed will give them a signature victory. Centrists warn that picking him will backfire in November. Acrimony is everywhere.
